_curatorNotes: genshin-db stub artifact fixed: behavior 'stance' → 'instant' (removed the stance 'duration' field). Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is a 20s buff STATE, not a weapon stance: it does not convert Illuga's normals and it persists while Illuga is OFF-field (stacks are consumed by nearby ACTIVE party members' Geo hits). Nightingale's Song DMG bonus deliberately NOT authored as an effect. It is a per-hit FLAT damage add scoped to the Geo element (base TL10 = 60.5% of Illuga's EM; Lunar-Crystallize TL10 = 406.7% of EM; A4 adds a further 7/14/24% EM base and 48/96/160% EM Lunar-Crystallize for 1/2/3 Hydro-or-Geo party members). The Stat vocabulary has no element-scoped flat-DMG key (flat-DMG stats are attack-class-scoped: normalFlatDmg…burstFlatDmg; lunarCrystallizeFlatDmg exists but authoring only the Lunar-Crystallize sliver while the far-more-common base Geo portion stays unmodelable would misrepresent the kit). Stubbed with a user caveat instead — see flags.

Duration 20s, CD 15s, energy 60 — all confirmed vs sidecar.

The 20s window itself IS on screen: the A1 passive's onCast buffs (critRate/geoCritDmg/em, duration 20) and the C4 DEF buff all fire on the burst cast and draw 20s bars, which the caveat's own second sentence admits. Hitmark 48, SetCD 15s (no delay). The burst status (Nightingale's Song) is 20s in the PR.

↻ NIGHTINGALE'S SONG IS A STACK POOL NOW, 2026-09-16 (T0.5), on Alyosha's Hunter's Mark shape. PR #2677 burst.go:48-72 sets `c.nightingalesSong = 21` at the cast (+5 per Geo Construct within 30 units, max +15), and burstBuffInit's OnEnemyHit hook spends one per Geo hit. `scope: 'rotation'` because the pool is a resource ON ILLUGA that survives a swap — teammates spend it while she is off field — which is exactly the axis that scope decides.

⚠️ `source: 'active'`, NOT `'others'` as the T0.5 report proposed. gcsim's gate is `atk.Info.ActorIndex != c.Core.Player.Active()` → return, i.e. the hit must come from the character the player is CONTROLLING — which INCLUDES Illuga herself whenever she is on field, and `'others'` would refuse exactly those. `filter.element: 'geo'` is gcsim's `atk.Info.Element != Geo` check; every attack tag it accepts (burst / skill / hold / normal / charged / plunge / direct Lunar-Crystallize) is covered by leaving `abilityType` off.

⚠️⚠️ NO PIXEL MOVES YET AND THAT IS EXPECTED — don't read this as the mechanic being modelled. The pool is tracked and spent, but the thing that would SHOW it is the truncation: gcsim deletes the 20s burst status the moment the pool empties (`if c.nightingalesSong < 1 { c.DeleteStatus(burstKey) }`), so the A1 crit/EM bars and the C4 DEF bar should end early and today draw a flat 20s. Ending a timed window on a stack count has no primitive; the pool is its prerequisite. ⛔ The other two unmodelled halves stay out for stated reasons: the per-hit EM-scaled flat DMG add has no element-scoped flat-DMG Stat key, and C2's Aedon strike fires every 7 stacks consumed, which no procCooldown-shaped gate expresses. ⚠️ `max: 21` rather than 36 because the Geo-Construct bonus needs a construct count the parser does not have; a recast re-caps to 21, which is what gcsim's assignment does.

⚠️⚠️ MEASURED SEAM, NEW 2026-09-16: a rotation-scoped pool is NOT drained by a TEAMMATE's hit, though the trigger matches. `dispatchConsumeStacksOnHit` writes through `poolsFor(...)` only when the holder IS the hitter; for any other holder it writes to `CharState.onHitStacks`, a different container from the `rotationStacks` a `scope: 'rotation'` grant lives in. Measured `Illuga Q > Zhongli E Q N1 N2 N3 > Illuga E`: Zhongli lands four Geo applications and the pool reads 21 → 20, spent only by Illuga's own E. ⛔ Authored as `source: 'active'` anyway, because that is the mechanic; ⛔ don't narrow it to `'self'` to match the engine. ✅ Verified it does not CORRUPT the pool either — the non-self write lands on the other map and the snapshot at the next cast is intact. Fix this before the truncation.

↻ 2026-09-21: TEAMMATES SPEND THE POOL NOW. The note above says they do; measured, they did not — `dispatchConsumeStacksOnHit` wrote `onHitStacks` for any hitter but the holder, a container nothing reads for a rotation-scoped key, so `Illuga Q > Ningguang N1 N2 N3 N1 N2 N3 E > Illuga E` left the pool at 20 (her own burst hit and nothing else). It writes the key's HOME (`homeOf`) now: the same rotation reads 0 (Ningguang's swings land two Geo hits each), a Zhongli partner spends one for his E and none for the stele's pulses (`source: 'active'` refuses an entity), a Pyro partner spends nothing. ⏭ The truncation this was the prerequisite for — ending the 20s windows when the pool empties — is still unbuilt: a timed window ended by a stack count has no primitive.

↻ 2026-09-21 (event-ended buffs round): HAUNTED NIGHT'S ORIOLE-SONG IS A STATE NOW — `opensTransientState: { state: 'orioleSong', duration: 20 }`, opened at the press like gcsim's `AddStatus(burstKey, 20*60)`. The spend is gated on it (gcsim's hook returns unless the status is active) and carries `closesStateWhenEmpty`, so the hit that takes the last stack ends the state at that instant — gcsim's `if c.nightingalesSong < 1 { c.DeleteStatus(burstKey) }`, the kit's "when all stacks … have been consumed … the effect will end". ⚠️⚠️ THE 2026-09-16 NOTE ABOVE IS WRONG ABOUT WHAT ENDS WITH IT: the A1 crit/EM bars do NOT. A1 (Lightkeeper's Oath) is a flat 20s from the skill OR the burst in both the kit text and gcsim (`asc.go` `a1()`, `NewBaseWithHitlag(…, 20*60)`, called from both casts) and never looks at the burst status. Only C4 does.
abilities.description:
Light the lamp, dealing AoE Geo DMG, and gain Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect for 20s. When this effect is active, Illuga gains 21 stacks of **Nightingale's Song**. When Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts of nearby active party members deal Geo DMG to opponents, 1 stack of Nightingale's Song is consumed to increase the DMG dealt. Increase in DMG is based on Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If DMG is inflicted by Lunar-Crystallize, DMG dealt will increase further.
When Geo DMG dealt in this manner hits multiple opponents, multiple stacks of Nightingale's Song will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.

Additionally, if there are Geo Constructs created by nearby party members on the battlefield while Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst, or when nearby party members create Geo Constructs while Haunted Night's Oriole-Song is active, every Geo Construct on the battlefield will allow Illuga to gain 5 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song. Within 20s after unleashing his Elemental Burst, Illuga can gain a maximum of 15 additional stacks of Nightingale's Song this way.

When all stacks of Nightingale's Song have been consumed, or when the state's duration ends, the Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect will end.

passives.name: Torchforger's Covenant
passives.caveat: The CRIT Rate bonus is shown as a general crit buff; in game it applies only to the party’s Geo damage.
_curatorNotes: Ascension 1 passive (icy-veins / genshin.gg). Trigger set to onCast with no ability filter so it fires after either the Elemental Skill OR the Elemental Burst (fixed the inherited 'manual' placeholder). Target 'teamExcludingSelf' — the text says OTHER nearby party members gain Lightkeeper's Oath; Illuga does not buff himself here.

CRIT DMG portion authored as geoCritDmg (Gorou C6 precedent — 'increases the CRIT DMG of party members' Geo DMG'). CRIT Rate portion authored as generic critRate because there is no geoCritRate stat in the vocabulary; the Geo-only scoping is surfaced in the user caveat. EM portion is a plain (non-Geo-scoped) EM buff.

C6 (Nightmare Orioles) enhances these totals to +10% CR / +30% geoCD / +80 EM — AUTHORED via constellationScaling (value REPLACES the base, matching the in-game 'enhanced to' wording, not additive). The C6 node therefore carries no standalone buff effects.

⚠️⚠️ ↻ 2026-08-18 — AUTHORED IS NOT MODELED, and the note above said 'modeled'. `BuffEffect.constellationScaling` (src/lib/types/ability.ts:1199) has NO reader on any display path: grep it over src/lib and every hit is either `gainStacks.constellationScaling` (a different field, same shape — src/lib/sim/stacks.ts:107/263/442, the per-fire grant amount) or `summonTick.tickCapScaling` (summons.ts:211), plus the lint. It appears NOWHERE in buffWindows.ts or buffDisplay.ts. So at C6 the three bars still print +5% CRIT Rate / +10% geoCritDmg / +50 EM — the bar draws, the who-renders check passes, the NUMBER is wrong. Rubric N9 names this character as the worked example (six authored buff uses corpus-wide: Illuga ×3, Linnea C1, Skirk, Varesa, Xianyun A4).

⏭ WORK ITEM: the fix is a reader, not data — resolve `constellationScaling` where the buff pool is built or where the value is formatted (buffWindows.ts / buffDisplay.ts), with the same 'definitively-true condition REPLACES the base' contract `tickCapOf` already implements for `tickCapScaling`. ⛔ Until that exists, do not author any further C6 value upgrade as `constellationScaling` and call it modeled — and ⛔ do not 'work around' it by adding a second C6-conditioned buff effect on the same stat, because the buff pools dedupe by `stat` before per-segment condition evaluation and would silently keep whichever was authored first.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam EM buff gated on teamFaction faction:moonsign min:2 (Lauma/Flins Ascendant-Gleam precedent). NOTE: Illuga's own utility passive raises the party's Moonsign by 1, so the true activation threshold may be lower than a bare min:2 count — flagged for Nate.

constellations.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
_curatorNotes: Aedon strike: 400% of Illuga's EM + 200% of his DEF, single-target Geo, counted as Burst DMG. Added the DEF portion (flatScaling def 200) and Geo element that the stub dropped. Trigger left 'manual': it fires once per 7 Nightingale's Song stacks consumed during the burst window — there is no primitive for 'per-N-stacks-consumed', and there is no gcsim/FrameMap source for its timing. Real off-field damage (Aedon strikes autonomously while Illuga is off-field), so it registers as a C2 off-field-DMG capability.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 Elk With Fanged Antlers — effects[0] (damage 400% em + 200% def, geo) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: absent from gcsim — the checkout has no `internal/characters/illuga/` (111 character dirs, none matching). Illuga's frames came from the UNMERGED PR #2677, whose head may still move; there is no oracle for Aedon's cadence, delay or durability. Retained: `_curatorNotes` must keep the whole magnitude and its provenance — Aedon: 400% EM + 200% DEF, single-target Geo, counted as Burst DMG, one strike per 7 Nightingale's Song stacks consumed during Haunted Night's Oriole-Song; real off-field damage. And it must keep WHY there is no trigger: "per N stacks CONSUMED" is not `onStack`. `onStack` fires when the SUM of its keys REACHES `count` while ACCRUING and then SPENDS the whole set to zero (`ability.ts` `onStack` doc; `sim/thresholds.ts` is its one reader) — Illuga's pool is seeded at 21 by the burst and DRAINS, so `{keys:['nightingalesSong'], count:7}` would both read the wrong edge and annihilate the pool the burst's own truncation depends on. No queued primitive covers a drain threshold, so this is not a DEFER. ⚠️ ⚠️ the existing note's closing claim — "it registers as a C2 off-field-DMG capability" — is FALSE and must be struck, not carried forward. `effectCapability` (`deriveCapabilities.ts:289-308`) has no `damage` arm and returns `null`; the only route from a `damage` effect to `offFieldDamage` is `pushSummonCapabilities` (`:441-442`), which requires a `summonTick` trigger on a `Summon.effects[]` host. This effect reaches nothing today and would reach nothing with any trigger short of that.
constellations.description: When Elemental Burst **Shadowless Reflection**'s Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of **Nightingale's Song** consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of Geo DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
